name: mesh-gradient-background

frames.best_why: Bright white bloom fills the centre behind the headline, showing the gradient pools at full strength.

tagline: Bright green glow pools drift behind a large white heading.
summary: A bright green animated backdrop with a bold white line of text centred over it; soft light pools swell and shift behind the words as it runs.
appearance: The frame is a bright lime-green field filled with soft, rounded pools of lighter and darker green, like light through water. Centred in white, heavy sans-serif text reads 'Fresh ideas, daily', casting a faint drop shadow.
behaviour: The green pools keep swelling and drifting across the field, brightening to near-white in places, so the backdrop slowly changes without any input. The heading stays fixed and readable throughout.
use_when: A marketing hero wants a bright, energetic backdrop with a place for a large headline.
avoid_when: Light text on lime green has weak contrast, and the saturated field fights most brand palettes.
customise: Only the headline text is a prop (title); the green palette, gradient shape, camera and lighting are fixed inside the file and need editing.
weight_why: A Three.js canvas with bloom, ambient occlusion and noise post-processing runs every frame.

a11y.note: Canvas has no role or description and the perpetual motion ignores prefers-reduced-motion; the headline itself is real, readable text.

issues: White text on lime green has low contrast, softened further by the drop shadow.
The 3D blob is almost invisible against the same-green background, so the effect reads as a plain blur.
polish_why: Smooth, bright gradient and clean typography; the white-on-lime headline is hard to read.
title: Mesh Gradient Background
